themes.label: Stand-down lines tested before the NVDA print
themes.narrative: The market is de-risking into NVDA's report tonight: VIX is up 9.69% intraday and the index is sliding toward its 200-day, so the tape treats the print as a binary event.
themes.dataAnchor: Intraday at 12:50 ET: VIX 25.13, above the 25 stand-down line (Monday close 22.91, 20-day change +36.28%); SPY $731.65 (-1.12%), which scales SPX to roughly 7,333 against its 200-day at $7,342.71; HY OAS 3.34, up from 3.23 but still below the 4% line. The episode block is still through Monday's close: SPX 5.46% below its 120-day high, tally 1 of 4.
themes.counterRead: Both triggers are close-based, so neither has tripped yet; a late-day reversal leaves the ladder where it was. But a close with VIX above 25 and SPX below its 200-day would trip two rungs at once, before the NVDA number lands — the stand-down then governs regardless of how the print reads.
themes.watchFor: Today's close: VIX above 25 and SPX below $7,342.71 (both trip the stand-down and the escalation rung).

themes.label: Rotation, not rollover — but the gap is not closing
themes.narrative: The index still reads as a pullback: SPY is 6.4% below its 52-week high and down 3.08% over the month, while the megacaps that dominate it are in a deeper drawdown.
themes.dataAnchor: Mag7 averages 19.41% below 52-week highs versus SPY at 6.4%, a 13.01-point divergence gap; weakest NVDA at 36.9% below its high, strongest AAPL at 2.7%. Bank lending standards are LOOSE (SLOOS 1.7%). QQQ is down 8.99% over the month and 1.2% today; IWM is down 0.33% over the month.
themes.counterRead: Loose lending standards keep this a rotation read, but SPY is now giving ground too (-4.54% over the month, -1.12% today). SPY is about 38% of the portfolio, so if the index joins the megacaps the portfolio's ballast stops working.
themes.watchFor: SLOOS print above 10%, or the Mag7/SPY divergence gap widening past 20 points.

themes.label: AI infrastructure: fundamentals ahead of price, decided tonight
themes.narrative: The market prices the AI build-out as peaked: NVDA is down 29.25% over the month and another 1.63% today, and SMH closed Monday 31.25% below its 120-day high.
themes.dataAnchor: Revenue keeps growing while prices fall: AVGO +55% YoY at 32.6% below its high (score 81, tier A); DDOG +27.7% YoY, 80% gross margin, $1,001M FCF, 42.5% below its high (score 84, tier A); ONTO +41.5% YoY, 49.1% below (score 81); AMAT 52.6% below (score 80); NVDA +61.4% YoY with RSI 22.7 at Monday's close.
themes.counterRead: Fundamentals ahead of price is an opportunity only if tonight's print confirms them (EPS consensus $2.49). A beat with guidance that holds is the catalyst; a miss on a day the stand-down lines are already being tested turns these DATA_AHEAD names into the next leg down. No buys before the print, and none on a stand-down day after it.
themes.watchFor: NVDA tonight after the close: EPS vs $2.49 and guidance; then the next-day close vs its $175 Zone 2 floor.

themes.label: Nuclear / AI power still bleeding
themes.narrative: The nuclear and AI-power trade keeps unwinding — the market treats it as an AI-capex derivative and sells it with NVDA.
themes.dataAnchor: VST is down 14.27% over the month and 1.4% today; at Monday's close it was $130.16, 31.2% below its peak, with $1.17M of insider buying at the trough (conviction 83). VRT was $188.67 Monday, 50.3% below its peak. Over the month: SMR -26.98%, CCJ -19.27%, OKLO -18.14% (-3.17% today), URA -14.57%.
themes.counterRead: VST and VRT are holdings, so this is a hold decision, not a buy. Insider buying argues sentiment, but VST's revenue reads STABLE_OR_DECLINING and the group trades on NVDA's tape — it will not find its own floor until the print is digested.
themes.watchFor: VST, CCJ and SMR: two consecutive closes without new lows after the NVDA print.

themes.label: Leveraged and crypto complex unwinding together
themes.narrative: The leveraged complex is being sold as one risk bucket, and today spot crypto joined in.
themes.dataAnchor: Over the month: CONL -55.14% (-6.39% today), TQQQ -27.7% (-3.7% today), BMNR -25.94% (-1.75% today), DOGE -25.87%, COIN -30.85%, IBIT -22.17%, ETH-USD -24.08%, BTC-USD -21.16%. Today BTC is -1.73% and ETH -2.02% — Monday's non-confirmation (crypto flat while equities fell) did not hold.
themes.counterRead: Monday hinted the crypto leg was pausing; today it is falling with equities again, which re-opens the unwind read. TQQQ, CONL, BMNR and DOGE are holdings — this is where portfolio pain concentrates, and leverage doubles or triples whatever NVDA does tonight.
themes.watchFor: BTC: a fresh -5% day confirms the unwind is re-opening; two flat-to-up days while equities fall would revive the pause read.

strategyPosture: Watch, leaning stand-down. No new money: VIX is above 25 intraday and SPX is testing its 200-day hours before NVDA reports; if both close past their lines, the stand-down rung governs through the print. Hold existing positions and do not average down in the leveraged names.
whereWaveBuilds: Today's close sets the conditions and NVDA's report tonight decides the direction: a beat with VIX back under 25 opens a relief move toward the SPX failure zone $7,750-7,820, while a miss on top of a close below the 200-day $7,342.71 starts the correction's next leg. FOMC minutes tomorrow are the second trigger.
watchFor: Today's close: VIX above 25 (stand-down) and SPX vs its 200-day $7,342.71 (escalation).
NVDA tonight after the close: EPS vs $2.49 and guidance; then a close back above its $175 Zone 2 floor.
HY OAS: 3.34 today, up from 3.23; a move above 4% trips the stand-down regardless of equities.
SMH close back above its $470 Zone 2 floor; a close below $461.90 extends the breakdown.
BTC: a fresh -5% day re-opens the crypto unwind.

reaction.episode: CORRECTION episode; the episode block is through the Nov 16 close (SPX 5.46% below its 120-day high and 1.01% above its 200-day; SMH and NVDA below Zone 2; HY OAS 3.23; tally 1 of 4). Intraday Nov 17 at 12:50 ET, VIX is 25.13, HY OAS 3.34 and SPY -1.12%, putting SPX near its 200-day.

ladder.response: Hold cash, no buys; wait for a failed first bounce and a second low that holds before re-checking bottom conditions.

ladder.trigger: VIX closes above 25 or HY OAS above 4%
ladder.response: Stand down all deployment until both are back below their lines; no averaging down in TQQQ, CONL or BMNR.

ladder.trigger: NVDA gaps up on the print and SPX bounces into the failure zone $7,750-7,820, or SMH into $580-600
ladder.response: Treat as the bull-trap test: no chasing. Require a close above the zone plus a tally of at least 3 before any Add.

ladder.trigger: NVDA closes back above $175 AND SMH closes inside Zone 2 $470-505 AND tally at least 3 of 4
ladder.response: Re-entry review: move AVGO, DDOG and ONTO to Probe; size only on a second confirming close.

reaction.invalidation: An SPX close above $7,820 with SMH above $600 and the tally at least 3 voids the Watch stance and flips the posture to Probe/Add; HY OAS above 4% voids the 'correction, not crisis' read and the ladder with it.
reaction.trapRisk: The trap is a gap-up on a good NVDA number while VIX is still above 25: NVDA was oversold at Monday's close (RSI 22.7), so a relief gap is likely and can fail within days. Entries wait for VIX back under 25, the failure-zone retest verdict, and a second low that holds — never the gap-up open.
